The Ajman pharmacy fills a prescription in 22 minutes. Its five sister branches: 9.
Why 22 minutes? Because the pharmacist checks stock by hand. Why? Because the system shows wrong quantities. Why? …
You picked the first branch you saw. A cause map with four branches would ask about the rota, the clinic next door and the counter layout too.
And where do we stop? One 'why' too far and the answer becomes 'because of the universe'.
